authorization: User requested a $50 lower price and one more article than the inspected $399/four-article entry plan, then explicitly selected $349 production-only, $449 with Brochure Care and $595 with Commerce Care.

plan.name: Local Search Partnership
plan.fit: An eligible single-location service business with an accessible website and willingness to supply real expertise and proof.
plan.result: Five researched articles or useful service pages, written, optimized and published each month, plus local profile/listing work and one conversion improvement. Care is optional.
includes: One location and one primary service market; up to 30 supported marketing pages. $349/month production only, $449 with Brochure Care or $595 with Commerce Care. Supported stores receive service/information-page work, not product/category ecommerce SEO.

An initial 90-day topic and local-presence plan; monthly Search Console/GA4/profile review where data are available. Track up to 10 agreed non-branded query themes, without presenting unstable ranking checks as guaranteed results.

Five new researched articles or useful service pages each month, using the existing supported design and publishing setup. Each answers one agreed buyer question or service purpose. Content length follows the topic, reader and search intent, without a fixed word quota. Each complete article counts once; research, publishing and checks are not separate deliverables.

Each article includes topic and search-intent research, original writing from checked sources and client expertise, factual review, page title and headings, relevant internal links, publishing, and readability/mobile/link checks. One consolidated client review round is included. Client-specific claims and proof need approval before publication.
Monthly accuracy review of one Google Business Profile; up to five simple data/service/hour updates and up to five owner-approved review-reply drafts where there are reviews to answer.
Check up to five agreed priority business listings; submit up to one correction where access permits. Submissions and approvals are reported separately.
A written monthly strategy review (or optional 30-minute appointment) and report on completed work, available impressions/clicks/inquiries, attribution limits and next priorities.
Write and publish up to two short owner-approved Google profile update posts monthly, using existing approved facts/assets. This replaces the former conditional outreach/substitute-listing activity.

One additional bounded conversion improvement: refine one call-to-action section, confirmation message or existing ordinary form/journey component. Agree one specific acceptance check; implement and regression-test it within the existing design. No new integration, calculator, page or A/B-test campaign. This is additional to all five articles.
When Brochure Care is selected, the shared hosting-offset rule covers up to $25/month of documented eligible hosting. Commerce and production-only variants have no hosting offset.

For the first three approved introductory production clients, Care onboarding is included when Care is chosen. The first cycle also includes missing supported native GA4/Search Console setup and one inquiry event; advanced measurement remains separate. All production outputs are still due in that paid cycle.

Before renewal, check whether the next five pages exceed supported limits. Agree any scope or fee expansion before payment, or do not renew. Every accepted cycle still includes all five outputs. Care keeps its separate coverage limits.
excludes: Multiple locations, national SEO, large ecommerce SEO or unlimited pages
Bulk/paid links, guaranteed rankings, review incentives or guaranteed lead/revenue increases
Social content calendars, multi-channel posting campaigns, advertising and email campaigns
Link outreach is excluded from this revised package. It is not quietly retained alongside the lower price.

New publishing platforms, custom page templates, original field research, specialist professional verification or custom interactive features. Agree separate work before accepting it; do not silently reduce the five included articles.
inputs: An eligible location/profile, client ownership and permitted access
Real service expertise, accurate facts and permission to use proof
Existing measurement access, or suitable access for the included first-cycle native setup; approval before profile posts/replies
acceptance: Five distinct, complete articles or service pages are approved, published and checked. A report lists their URLs, the question each answers and completed checks; one page cannot be counted twice. An existing-page refresh or technical repair replaces an article only with explicit written agreement.
Local profile/listing changes, submissions and posts are logged with submitted/approved status.
Reports distinguish search signals and inquiries from proven causation.
When Care is selected, Care is performed and duplicate care billing is prevented.
The additional agreed conversion change passes its acceptance check; it is not counted as a content/SEO unit.
plan.support: Acknowledge within one business day during the paid cycle and correct W&M-caused defects in the accepted output. Care triage/maintenance duties apply only when the selected variant includes Care; production-only is not incident response. Platform approval and indexing remain outside W&M control.
plan.changeType: User-approved five-article introductory production plan with optional Care
plan.reason: Offer five published articles for $349 production-only, $50 below the inspected $399/four-article entry offer; optional Care is priced separately.
plan.competitivePosition: The production headline is $50 lower and includes one additional article compared with the inspected Instant Nerds $399/four-article plan. This does not establish equal scope, execution quality or results.
plan.timeline: First article within 10 business days of a ready paid cycle; remaining articles on the agreed publishing calendar, with all five completed within the paid cycle
hours: Five articles including research, writing and revisions
Profile updates, two posts and review-reply drafts
QA and publication for five articles
One bounded conversion change, review and regression test
plan.note: Five complete researched articles or service pages are included each paid cycle. They are not five fragments, keyword substitutions or separate steps on the same page. Research and normal editorial depth are included in each article. Care is optional. Missing profile setup or unsupported technical work is agreed separately; basic native measurement setup remains included in the first cycle.

timingTerms.display: First article within 10 business days of a ready paid cycle; remaining articles on the agreed publishing calendar, with all five completed within the paid cycle
timingTerms.start: Paid cycle with an agreed five-topic plan, ready facts, access and publishing permissions
timingTerms.externalDependency: Profile/vendor approvals and search results are not guaranteed by this timeline.

limits: Introductory offer within the existing dated delivery-capacity and three-client monthly pilot gates. Hours remain unmeasured planning estimates, not profit or owner pay. Accepted historical contracts are unchanged.

capacityReview.decision: Brochure and Commerce first cycles exceed the ordinary four-week recurring allocation. Accept only when the dated capacity calendar reserves the complete first cycle and ongoing work; reallocate project capacity explicitly if needed. The three-client introductory eligibility limit is not a promise of three available full retainers. No work or output is removed from an accepted cycle.
